cn_title: 吉田直树：史克威尔艾尼克斯称《最终幻想7 重制版》式重制FF6等或分5部
subtitle: 工程量惊人
summary: 吉田直树表示，若按《最终幻想7重制版》的规模重制《最终幻想6》《最终幻想8》或《最终幻想9》，很可能需拆分为4至5部推出。滨口直树也称，开发团队连续十余年投入三部曲的经历近乎奇迹，因此无法轻易承诺重制FF6。
opus_summary: 吉田直树称，若以《最终幻想7重制版》的规模重制《最终幻想6》《最终幻想8》或《最终幻想9》，可能需分4至5部推出。滨口直树表示，三部曲团队连续十余年投入开发近乎奇迹，不能轻易承诺重制FF6。

paragraphs.en: At the Final Fantasy 14 Fan Festival in Berlin on Sunday, Final Fantasy 14 director-producer Naoki “Yoshi-P” Yoshida invited Final Fantasy 7 Remake series director Naoki Hamaguchi to the stage for a chat. Over this 75-minute Naoki’s Room section , the two Final Fantasy devs discussed their motivations, upcoming FF7/FF14 crossover content, and the future of the series. However, one comment may have quashed fans’ hopes for Final Fantasy 6, Final Fantasy 8, or Final Fantasy 9 ever getting the remake treatment.
paragraphs.cn: 周日的柏林《最终幻想14》粉丝节上，《最终幻想14》制作人兼导演吉田直树邀请《最终幻想7重制版》系列总监滨口直树登台对谈。在长达75分钟的「Naoki’s Room」环节中，两位《最终幻想》开发者谈及各自的创作动机、即将推出的FF7/FF14联动内容及系列未来。不过，吉田的一句话或许让粉丝对《最终幻想6》《最终幻想8》与《最终幻想9》获得重制的期待落空。

paragraphs.en: The talk of remaking other FF games came up when Hamaguchi named Final Fantasy 6 as a big influence on his life. “Final Fantasy 6 is the reason I wanted to work in the game industry and it will always have a special place in my heart," he said. He added that whenever he mentions this in interviews, it inevitably sparks hopes and headlines that Hamaguchi will remake FF6, something that he always has to deny.
paragraphs.cn: 谈话转向其他FF游戏的重制，起因是滨口直树称《最终幻想6》对自己的人生产生了很大影响。他说：「《最终幻想6》让我想进入游戏行业，它在我心中永远占有特殊位置。」他补充道，每当自己在采访中提起这件事，总会不可避免地引发「滨口将重制FF6」的期待和新闻标题，而这一直是他不得不否认的说法。

paragraphs.en: Yoshida added, “I understand fans’ feelings. But please think about it." He then went on to explain why these remakes would be such a huge effort to develop and release.
paragraphs.cn: 吉田补充说：「我理解粉丝的心情，但请仔细想想。」随后，他解释了为何开发并推出这些重制版会是一项如此浩大的工程。

paragraphs.en: "Final Fantasy 6 is an incredibly huge game, and the same goes for other titles like Final Fantasy 8 and Final Fantasy 9. Since Final Fantasy 7 Remake, I understand why people ask for these remakes. But if we did remake these other games, we would probably have to release them in four or even five installments.”
paragraphs.cn: 「《最终幻想6》是一款规模大得惊人的游戏，《最终幻想8》《最终幻想9》等作品也是如此。自《最终幻想7重制版》问世以来，我理解大家为什么会要求重制这些游戏。但如果我们真的重制其他作品，可能不得不分成4部，甚至5部来推出。」

paragraphs.en: Some have taken Yoshida's comments here to pour cold water on the chances of further Final Fantasy remakes in the Final Fantasy7 remake style. They echo those Final Fantasy 6 director Yoshinori Kitase issued in 2024 , when he sad a Final Fantasy 6 remake akin to that of Final Fantasy 7's could take around 20 years to complete.
paragraphs.cn: 一些人将吉田这番话解读为给以《最终幻想7重制版》形式继续重制《最终幻想》作品的前景泼了冷水。这也呼应了《最终幻想6》总监北濑佳范在2024年的说法：若制作一款类似《最终幻想7重制版》的《最终幻想6》重制版，完成或许需要约20年。

paragraphs.en: Kitase said that because of the depth of Final Fantasy 6, with so much content and so many characters, it would take twice the length of Final Fantasy 7 Remake to develop and release.
paragraphs.cn: 北濑表示，《最终幻想6》内容丰富、角色众多，因其深度，开发并推出它所需的时间会是《最终幻想7重制版》的两倍。

paragraphs.en: Hamaguchi went on to shout-out the Final Fantasy Remake trilogy team for their dedication and for sticking with him for over 10 years of development. “Not only was it a matter of timing, I think it was a miracle that we were able to get these people who were willing to stick around and keep motivated to work on so many of these titles back-to-back,” he said. “So that’s why I can’t just say, ‘Yeah, I’ll remake FF6,’ as it's not quite that simple.”
paragraphs.cn: 滨口接着称赞了《最终幻想》重制三部曲团队的投入，以及他们陪伴自己开发超过10年。他说：「这不只是时机问题。我认为，能有这些人愿意留下来，持续保持动力，接连投入这么多部作品的开发，简直是个奇迹。所以我不能简单地说‘好，我来重制FF6’，事情没那么简单。」

paragraphs.en: At the end of the talk, Yoshida pointed out that after they had mentioned the difficulties of remaking FF6 and other titles, there were many comments from livestream viewers along the lines of, ‘I want this guy (Hamaguchi) to make Final Fantasy 17,’ which Yoshida described as “the highest praise you could get.” Hamaguchi replied: “Can I respond to that? If I do…” but Yoshida waved him away.
paragraphs.cn: 对谈末尾，吉田指出，在两人提到重制FF6及其他作品的困难后，直播观众涌现了许多诸如「我想让这家伙（滨口）制作《最终幻想17》」的留言。吉田称这是「你能得到的最高赞誉」。滨口回应：「我可以对此作出回应吗？如果我回应……」但吉田挥手制止了他。

paragraphs.en: This promoted many excited comments from viewers as to what this meant and if we can take this to mean that Square Enix has already decided to make Final Fantasy 17. Some have even interpreted this as a sign that Hamaguchi may already be slated to work on Final Fantasy 17, but it seems pretty tenuous to assume that, especially considering he still has his hands full with the upcoming Final Fantasy 7 Revelation.
paragraphs.cn: 这引发观众热烈讨论：这究竟意味着什么，是否可以理解为史克威尔艾尼克斯已决定制作《最终幻想17》。还有人甚至将其解读为滨口可能已被安排参与《最终幻想17》开发的信号，但这种推断似乎相当牵强，尤其考虑到他仍忙于即将推出的《Final Fantasy 7 Revelation》。

paragraphs.en: Yoshida then asked Hamaguchi for both his most difficult and most rewarding experiences working on the Final Fantasy franchise. As a manager with a huge team of people, Hamaguchi said the most difficult thing is to unite everyone behind the same vision for the game and make sure they are heading in the same direction. According to Hamaguchi, the most rewarding thing is being able to make these games with the support of such a huge, global fanbase. “I don’t think anything could make me happier," he added.
paragraphs.cn: 随后，吉田请滨口谈谈自己参与《最终幻想》系列时最困难、也最有成就感的经历。身为管理庞大团队的负责人，滨口说，最困难的是让所有人围绕同一个游戏愿景团结起来，并确保大家朝同一方向前进。滨口认为，最有成就感的是能在如此庞大的全球粉丝群支持下制作这些游戏。他补充道：「我想没有什么能让我更开心了。」

paragraphs.en: Looking back on his career, Hamaguchi reminisced about how he spent ages fine-tuning fire effects on Final Fantasy 12 when he first started out as a programmer at Square Enix 24 years ago. “As an individual creator, it’s very satisfying to get immersed in your work. However, I think that’s something you’re able to do more earlier in your career. Later on, the satisfaction comes more from leading a team and getting them to utilize their abilities.” he explained. “This doesn’t change how I feel about the games. I still want to make something amazing.”
paragraphs.cn: 回顾职业生涯时，滨口忆起自己24年前刚以程序员身份加入史克威尔艾尼克斯时，曾花很长时间微调《最终幻想12》的火焰效果。他解释道：「作为独立创作者，沉浸于工作中很有满足感。不过，我觉得这种事更多是在职业生涯早期才能做到。之后，满足感更多来自带领团队，并让他们发挥自身能力。这不会改变我对游戏的感受，我依然想做出令人惊叹的作品。」

paragraphs.en: Yoshida and Hamaguchi then turned their attention to the new FF7-themed content coming to FF14 that their teams are collaborating on. This includes the Keybound Brawler game coming to FF14’s Golden Saucer in October, plus new Barret and Tifa-style outfits. The teams are currently working on the crossover raid Beyond the Lifestream, which will bring the FF7 remake series to FF14. It’s scheduled to come out with version 8.01 of Final Fantasy 14 (release date TBC, but set to drop before Final Fantasy 7 Revelations comes out in early 2027).
paragraphs.cn: 接着，吉田和滨口把话题转向双方团队正为FF14合作制作的全新FF7主题内容。这包括10月登陆FF14金碟游乐场的《Keybound Brawler》游戏，以及全新的巴雷特和蒂法风格服装。团队目前正在制作联动团队副本「Beyond the Lifestream」，它将把FF7重制版系列带入FF14。该内容计划随《最终幻想14》8.01版本推出，发售日期待定，但预计会在《Final Fantasy 7 Revelations》于2027年初推出前上线。

paragraphs.en: Regarding Final Fantasy 7, Hamaguchi reiterated that the whole reason they started the remake trilogy was to bring FF7 to the next generation of players, many of whom never experienced the 1997 PS1 classic. “We want to introduce new players to Final Fantasy 7 in a way that they can really understand what made the original so great. So we went into more depth on the depiction of the world, the lore, characters and all these elements in the remake trilogy," he said.
paragraphs.cn: 谈到《最终幻想7》，滨口重申，他们启动重制三部曲的全部原因，是将FF7带给下一代玩家，其中许多人从未体验过1997年推出的PS1经典原作。他说：「我们希望以一种让新玩家真正理解原作伟大之处的方式，向他们介绍《最终幻想7》。因此，我们在重制三部曲中更深入地描绘了世界、设定、角色以及所有这些元素。」

paragraphs.en: Throughout the talk, both developers praised each other for their respective work and achievements, revealing they don’t need much sleep and are still enthusiastic and committed to the Final Fantasy series. Yoshida praised Hamaguchi as being the number one at Square Enix in terms of team, task and schedule management. Towards the end of the talk, Hamaguchi expressed hopes that he and Yoshida’s teams can collaborate more in the future.
paragraphs.cn: 整场对谈中，两位开发者都称赞了彼此的工作与成就，并透露他们不需要太多睡眠，仍对《最终幻想》系列满怀热情、全心投入。吉田称赞滨口在史克威尔艾尼克斯的团队、任务和日程管理方面首屈一指。对谈接近尾声时，滨口希望未来自己与吉田的团队能有更多合作。

paragraphs.en: Verity Townsend is a Japan-based freelance writer who previously served as editor, contributor and translator for the game news site Automaton West. She has also written about Japanese culture and movies for various publications.
paragraphs.cn: Verity Townsend是一位常驻日本的自由撰稿人，曾任游戏新闻网站Automaton West的编辑、撰稿人与译者。她还曾为多家刊物撰写有关日本文化和电影的文章。
